_note: Reference figures behind each signal. 'source' names an entry in data/sources.json. status: 'verified' (read in the source or its abstract), 'partly verified' (read in a summary of it), 'team choice' (a scale or setting Vigil defines, with no outside meaning), 'must_verify' (has an outside meaning but no source was found). These are context, not clinical limits: Vigil alerts on each person's own range.

resting_hr.note: Adults awake at rest. Fit adults often sit lower, so crew baselines average 62.

hrv.note: Short-term (about 5 minute) RMSSD in healthy adults: mean 42, SD 15. Crew baselines use the same mean and spread.

bp_sys.note: Normal is below 120. Stage 1 hypertension starts at 130 and stage 2 at 140. The 160 hard limit is the team's.

bp_dia.note: Normal is below 80. Stage 1 is 80 to 89 and stage 2 is 90 or higher. The 100 hard limit is the team's.

ortho_rise.note: A sustained rise of 30 bpm or more within 10 minutes of standing defines postural tachycardia in adults.

spo2.note: Normal saturation. The 90 percent hard limit is the team's.

exercise_min.note: ISS crews are scheduled 2.5 hours a day including setup, and average about 2 hours. Crew baselines average 120 minutes.

exercise_load.note: An arbitrary load index defined by Vigil.

grip.note: Peak medians are 51 kg for men and 31 kg for women. Crew baselines average 41 kg with a 10 kg spread.

bone_marker.note: The index itself is Vigil's. Its slow fall, about 7.5 percent over 180 days, follows the 1 to 1.5 percent a month bone loss reported in long flights.

lean_mass.note: A lean mass proxy that falls 1.2 kg over the mission. No source found for the rate.

temp.note: Mean oral temperature 36.8 C, upper limit of normal 37.7 C. The 38.5 C hard limit is the team's.

crp.note: Below 1 is low cardiovascular risk, 1 to 3 average, above 3 high. The 10 mg/L hard limit marks a likely acute cause.

il6.note: Mayo Clinic Laboratories reference interval. Upper limits differ between labs and assays.

lymph.note: Lymphocytes are 20 to 40 percent of white blood cells.

symptoms.note: A self-rated scale defined by Vigil.

sleep_hours.note: ISS crews averaged 6.09 hours a night against 8.5 scheduled. Crew baselines average 6.1 hours.

sleep_eff.note: The National Sleep Foundation lists being asleep for at least 85 percent of time in bed as a sign of good sleep quality.

mood.note: A self-rated scale defined by Vigil.

stress.note: A self-rated scale defined by Vigil.

energy.note: A self-rated scale defined by Vigil.

social_min.note: Minutes of social contact. The Mars-500 crews grew less active over time, which the behavioral slide follows.

journal.note: Tone score from Vigil's own word list.

fiber.note: Self-reported servings of fiber-rich food in the check-in, 0 to 5. Feeds Gut City only.

processed.note: Self-reported servings of processed food in the check-in, 0 to 5. Feeds Gut City only.

career_limit_msv.note: Career effective dose, all ages and sexes [V1 4030].

event_limit_msv.note: Per solar particle event, against the October 1989 events [V1 4031].

cruise_dose_msv_per_day.note: Mars cruise, mostly galactic cosmic rays. The simulation uses 76 uSv per hour.

mars_round_trip_dose_sv.note: Shortest round trip with current propulsion, plus or minus 0.12 Sv.

storm_reference_event.note: Start 13:10 UTC, peak 27 hours later at 42,200 pfu (>10 MeV).

free_space_usv_h_per_pfu.note: Team assumption that turns proton flux into dose rate in this ship. Real conversion depends on the energy spectrum and shielding.

shelter_factor.note: Team assumption: the storm shelter passes 40 percent of storm dose.

storm_warning_hours.note: Team assumption for how early a solar monitor warns.

one_way_delay_minutes.note: A signal takes 3 to 22 minutes one way, depending on where Earth and Mars are. Vigil uses the 22-minute worst case. CHAPEA used the same maximum.
